    Bug 2005852 - Change accesskey for the Empty Spam English menuitem. r=tobyp
    
    
    Right click on a `Spam` folder to see the menuitem.
    This should remove any duplicate accesskey from that menu.
    It shouldn't require a new Fluent ID since it's a `en-US` only change
    and localizers could/will have a different accesskey.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D276350

diff --git a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/messenger.ftl b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/messenger.ftl
index 073f2233059..67abd81db61 100644
--- a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/messenger.ftl
+++ b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/messenger.ftl
@@ -628,7 +628,7 @@ menu-delete-spam =
 
 folder-context-empty-spam =
   .label = Empty Spam
-  .accesskey = S
+  .accesskey = E
 
 ## Thread pane.
